{{Quote|Sir, our long range outpost on Delta 3 has picked up an Imperial strike force entering hyperspace.|[[Unidentified New Republic officer (Altyr V)|New Republic officer]]|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
'''Delta 3''' was a location controlled by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="MOTS" /> By [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">According to the opening crawl of the game ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'', the game's events take place five [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]] after the events of the game ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of the latter game to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Therefore, ''Mysteries of the Sith'' can be placed in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].</ref> the New Republic maintained a long-range outpost there with [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] to monitor for [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] activity. 

[[File:Four angry rebels.png|thumb|right|150px|New Republic officers discuss Delta 3's intel.]]
During the [[Dark Empire|Imperial's]] [[Operation Shadow Hand]] to strike back at New Republic [[Planet/Legends|planets]], those sensors detected an Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] traveling through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] to the [[Altyr V base|New Republic base]] on the planet [[Altyr V]]. The warning from Delta 3 gave the base's [[Unidentified New Republic commander|commander]] a three [[Time/Legends|hour]] lead to evacuate before the primary enemy force [[Battle of Altyr V (Galactic Civil War)|attacked]].<ref name="MOTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Delta 3 was mentioned in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''.<ref name="MOTS" />
